$comment: Single source of the official (FLAVOR=hermes) identity. Read by app/app.config.ts (OFFICIAL_IDENTITY), app/src/brand.ts, scripts/brand.sh, scripts/flavor-guard.mjs, scripts/make-pair-link.mjs, scripts/brand-icons.mjs and cross-checked by the bridge tests. The personal flavor never reads this file's ids (it uses $HUI_PRIVATE_DIR/app/identity.json). docs/BUILD.md (section Identity) explains every value. displayName is the on-device name (home screen, launcher, web app, desktop app); name / shortName are the project names (docs, website, GitHub); storeName is the App Store / Google Play listing title.
name: Hermes Interactive UI+
